name: KnowledgeCheckR
description: KnowledgeCheckR is a browser-based learning platform offering microlearning, spaced repetition, and gamification. It supports multiple question types, provides instant feedback, and is used for training, exams, and compliance in corporate and educational settings.

personas.name: Teacher
personas.description: A teacher who wants to create and manage knowledge checks (quizzes) to support student learning effectively.

tasks.name: Account Registration and Login
tasks.description: Register a new account using your email, then log in with the created credentials.

tasks.name: Knowledge Check Creation
tasks.description: Create a new knowledge check by providing a title, image, description, deadline, and adding 2 multiple-choice questions. Complete all required fields and save the knowledge check.

tasks.name: Knowledge Check Extension
tasks.description: Extend the created knowledge check by adding a 'Text-Segments' question, requiring learners to arrange text elements in the correct order.

tasks.name: Knowledge Check Settings
tasks.description: Enable anonymized access to a created knowledge check.

personas.name: Student
personas.description: A student who wants to access and complete knowledge checks (quizzes) to support their learning and evaluate their understanding.

tasks.name: Knowledge Check Access
tasks.description: Access the knowledge check without registration by using the provided access key.

tasks.name: Knowledge Check Completion
tasks.description: Complete the knowledge check by answering all questions.
